title: The Card Players, 1 dollar, Treasures of World Painting Collection
descriptionPlain: Description A classical painting of card players has been recreated in warm tones that faithfully capture the atmosphere of concentration and timeless elegance found in the famous work. The framed composition enhances intimacy and tradition. The design reflects careful study of expression and gesture. It brings fine art into a compact visual format.
